description.zh:
返回值语言，取值： 
          
- **zh-CN**：中文。

- **en-US**：英文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh-CN**: Chinese.

- **en-US**: English.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests. It can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

description.zh: 域名实例配置id，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识域名实例配置。
description.en: The ID of the instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This creates two instance configurations. \`ConfigId\` uniquely identifies an instance configuration.
The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.

title.zh: 获取实例配置的告警配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-cloud-gtm-instance-config-alert --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240022 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --config-id Config-0000011 --region cn-hangzhou
